newsitem.title: UK: Ex-Lands, General Accident in property pact.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Lands, General Accident in property pact.

text.p: Britain's Ex-Lands Properties Plc said on Tuesday it bought a 50-percent stake in a joint venture that planned to buy a portfolio of 40 properties from insurer General Accident Plc for 62.5 million stg.
The portfolio consisted mainly of retail and office properties in the UK, the company said in a statement.
Current net rental income receivable from the portfolio amounted to six million stg, producing an initial yield of 9.6 percent per annum, the company said.
Ex-Lands said it acquired a 50 percent interest in ELP Properties Ltd, a venture which also included Treasury Holdings and the Horney Trustees.

Ex-Lands Properties also said it agreed to a conditional contract to provide a subordinated loan of 1.7 million stg to ELP Properties and arranged a 5.5 million stg guarantee for ELP from its bankers.
